# genesyscloud_agentic_virtual_agent_version_publish (Resource)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/resources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud Agentic Virtual Agent Version Publish. Publishes a version for testing (TestReady) or production (ProductionReady).

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this resource. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [POST /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents/{virtualAgentId}/versions/{versionId}/jobs](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#post-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents--virtualAgentId--versions--versionId--jobs)
* [GET /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents/{virtualAgentId}/versions/{versionId}/jobs/{jobId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents--virtualAgentId--versions--versionId--jobs--jobId-)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `agentic:virtualAgentVersionJob:add`
* `agentic:virtualAgentVersionJob:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `agentic-virtualagents`
* `agentic-virtualagents:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "genesyscloud_agentic_virtual_agent_version_publish" "example_publish" {
  agent_id = genesyscloud_agentic_virtual_agent.example_agent.id
  version  = genesyscloud_agentic_virtual_agent_version.example_version.version
  status   = "ProductionReady"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) ID of the parent agentic virtual agent.
- `status` (String) Target publish status. TestReady publishes for preview testing, ProductionReady publishes for production use.
- `version` (String) Version number to publish (e.g. '1.0').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
